Text_UltimateMoveThatMon:
I perfected the ultimate move of its type…
But will no one take it for future use?
…Hm? Hmmm!
Y-you… Th-that {STR_VAR_1}…
Text_AllowMeToTeachMonUltimateMove:
Oh! This is the one! This is the POKéMON!
This {STR_VAR_1} is worthy of learning my ultimate move!
Will you allow it?
Will you allow your {STR_VAR_1} to learn my {STR_VAR_2}?
Text_YouRejectIt: Gaah! You reject it? No, I won't be dissuaded!
Text_LetMeConferUltimateMove:
You will allow it?
Then, let me confer my ultimate {STR_VAR_2} on your {STR_VAR_1}.
Ggggrah-awooo!
Text_TaughtMove:
Gasp, gasp, gasp…
I didn't think I could teach that move while I still lived…
Text_MakeBestUseOfMove: I implore you to make the best use of that move and gain power!
Text_PassedOnEverythingIKnow:
Gasp, gasp, gasp…
I have no regrets now. I've passed on everything I know.
Now I can live out my life knowing my work is done.
Text_FeelRejuvenated:
After I passed on my knowledge to you, I felt so much relief.
In fact, I feel rejuvenated, as if I were younger again!
